newsitem.title: USA: Computer Outsourcing gets $10 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Computer Outsourcing gets $10 mln contract.

text.p: Computer Outsourcing Services Inc has entered into a three-year outsourcing agreement with a new client for approximately $10.5 million, the company said on Wednesday.
The agreement is not expected to commence until later this year, when certain conditions are acheived.
The firm said it expects the new relationship will generate annual revenues of about $3.5 million.
COSI provides outsourced Information Technology systems, which include Information Processing services and Payroll Processing and Tax Filing services, to companies throughout the United States.
